related.title: 伊爾辛 4 號 H 級複循環機組
related.transfer: 可遷移「複循環的合成效率」與「汽包的升溫限制與啟動時間」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；伊爾辛 4 號 H 級複循環機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Combined-cycle efficiency" and "Drum heating limit and start-up time" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Irsching 4 H-Class Combined-Cycle Unit must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把燃氣渦輪機的廢熱變成蒸汽：可回收的熱、蒸汽產量與夾點、鍋爐效率與汽包的升溫限制；伊爾辛 4 號 H 級複循環機組則以第一部突破六成效率的機組：單軸配置、燃氣渦輪機的比功、效率的燃料價值與被封存的經濟學為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on turning gas turbine exhaust into steam: recoverable heat, steam output and the pinch, boiler efficiency and drum heating limits; Irsching 4 H-Class Combined-Cycle Unit centres on the first unit past sixty percent: single-shaft layout, specific work of the gas turbine, the fuel value of efficiency and the economics of mothballing, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「壓力比與布雷頓循環」與「壓力比與布雷頓循環」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「夾點與高壓蒸汽產量」的模型移到伊爾辛 4 號 H 級複循環機組，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「效率提高所省下的燃料」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle" and "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle".
Move the model of "The pinch and high-pressure steam output" to Irsching 4 H-Class Combined-Cycle Unit, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Fuel saved by higher efficiency", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「複循環的合成效率」與「汽包的升溫限制與啟動時間」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；伊爾辛 4 號 H 級複循環機組的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Combined-cycle efficiency" and "Drum heating limit and start-up time" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Irsching 4 H-Class Combined-Cycle Unit must be respecified.

related.title: 汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統
related.titleEn: Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「複循環的合成效率」與「汽包的升溫限制與啟動時間」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Combined-cycle efficiency" and "Drum heating limit and start-up time" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把燃氣渦輪機的廢熱變成蒸汽：可回收的熱、蒸汽產量與夾點、鍋爐效率與汽包的升溫限制；汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統則以汽輪機出口的那一點真空：冷卻水流量、飽和溫度與背壓、換熱面積、管數與抽氣為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on turning gas turbine exhaust into steam: recoverable heat, steam output and the pinch, boiler efficiency and drum heating limits; Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems centres on the bit of vacuum at a turbine's exit: cooling water flow, saturation temperature and back-pressure, surface area, tube count and air removal, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「壓力比與布雷頓循環」與「複循環的合成效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「夾點與高壓蒸汽產量」的模型移到汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「管數與管內流速」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle" and "Combined-cycle efficiency".
Move the model of "The pinch and high-pressure steam output" to Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tube count and velocity in the tubes", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「複循環的合成效率」與「汽包的升溫限制與啟動時間」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；汽輪機凝汽器與真空系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Combined-cycle efficiency" and "Drum heating limit and start-up time" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Steam Turbine Condensers and Vacuum Systems must be respecified.

history.titleEn: Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators
history.text: 2014 年機組工程開工；2016 年機組啟用並創下效率紀錄；2018 年後續機型再次刷新效率紀錄。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2014: Construction of the unit began. 2016: The unit opened and set the efficiency record. 2018: A later model broke the efficiency record again. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
